algorithm.ja: 形式的なFourier角度輸送→D=K_HO/E_HO→独立な有限差分モーメント式を反復します。Dxyの両交差微分を共有面流束へ含め、局所・大域の離散収支を確認します。
algorithm.en: Iterate formal Fourier angular transport, D=K_HO/E_HO, and an independent finite-difference moment solve. Include both Dxy cross derivatives in shared face fluxes and check local/global discrete budgets.

validation.ja: 17²/33²と12×48角度則、33²の16×64角度プローブを区別します。解析E/H/K/D、位相を含む複素モード、独立角度積分、テンソル制約、混合項の負制御、N=9²一定源を照合します。
validation.en: Separate17x17/33x33 refinement at12x48 angles from the16x64 angular probe on33x33. Check analytic E/H/K/D, complex modes including phase, independent angular integration, tensor constraints, cross-term negative controls and a9x9 constant source.
